secrets.name: Dropstone cluster
secrets.text: Several rocks rest on the polar mud. Icebergs can carry stones far from land and release them as the ice melts.

secrets.name: Detached rigging bundle
secrets.text: A compact bundle of waterlogged timber rests away from the ship in the polar sediment.

secrets.name: Marine-snow drift
secrets.text: Fine organic material collects in a sheltered pocket of the polar seabed.
